How much it recovers depends on the stage of liver damage and whether you stay completely alcohol-free.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1yD9oCh-F1JSY9qp7XCxH15_j19YJ42qCk0NtG56c8tVqHKxXopSBm9l7u9XJ3pFjJqcSL8YU-eyxpomq9GRKUCzdWgR3_TT00irK1DFAQTuesCMeRURv0WyWdGwHDG3w9Bye_inrz_hAN2NBG9DLnyOVfpR_tMtIjCRtTBdX-0Hy8gZOBZdM4vtHmRfFHJz8vOz7MgQlmfjVfN4vRx_WoVrvG0GketuSrXCb_M_0tS44eOF)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXGN5Rm9iucXIbHFvnHthkKjRq_g_NqAZK7Isv5mEvQRgkHmkAy6_-PP_NNbBUfTZDULaUEBPyD9qea1RQOJEsAux-5fICG1cru78nocC8R5agoNm54xWlBxYJGaxP6uFBSeOwlgPmX5bZ8Bglv-RcoQ6x-WLubYo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXXjCLsd4ki28nzPxeCxjOCQjBv5vhdIY6L_SwgJpjYLn3ZUl7ID2uKqtqRllTdlizmGy_BmteDU7_zX0-_E6JYoqGlPSrwk_H7OwKXTBTOaA_eBiNdyPvULsSYN2uGeT4Yy-eNk5bSw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1yxfrR5K-yscUQck4hQLG6LnixL6XI93MFH4xLWx3D0-hROvulBQaqEMZ_IYBtzXDP62JGswdJ_Mre6S7SQg2QccOdK2J6yLLPEf2uPvViCp9oLZul6HMT9VBMV3g14rEo_hYn4KIR1iGcsPDEJ6SYBsOt4YxQAqV4EvvrtZbD6_kL6vZJFrP8qF)

### Recovery by Stage of Damage

- **Fatty liver (steatosis):** Usually reverses within 2 to 4 weeks of stopping alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXGN5Rm9iucXIbHFvnHthkKjRq_g_NqAZK7Isv5mEvQRgkHmkAy6_-PP_NNbBUfTZDULaUEBPyD9qea1RQOJEsAux-5fICG1cru78nocC8R5agoNm54xWlBxYJGaxP6uFBSeOwlgPmX5bZ8Bglv-RcoQ6x-WLubYo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1yD9oCh-F1JSY9qp7XCxH15_j19YJ42qCk0NtG56c8tVqHKxXopSBm9l7u9XJ3pFjJqcSL8YU-eyxpomq9GRKUCzdWgR3_TT00irK1DFAQTuesCMeRURv0WyWdGwHDG3w9Bye_inrz_hAN2NBG9DLnyOVfpR_tMtIjCRtTBdX-0Hy8gZOBZdM4vtHmRfFHJz8vOz7MgQlmfjVfN4vRx_WoVrvG0GketuSrXCb_M_0tS44eOF)
- **Alcoholic hepatitis:** Mild inflammation often resolves with permanent abstinence. Severe alcoholic hepatitis is life-threatening and requires urgent medical care.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1yD9oCh-F1JSY9qp7XCxH15_j19YJ42qCk0NtG56c8tVqHKxXopSBm9l7u9XJ3pFjJqcSL8YU-eyxpomq9GRKUCzdWgR3_TT00irK1DFAQTuesCMeRURv0WyWdGwHDG3w9Bye_inrz_hAN2NBG9DLnyOVfpR_tMtIjCRtTBdX-0Hy8gZOBZdM4vtHmRfFHJz8vOz7MgQlmfjVfN4vRx_WoVrvG0GketuSrXCb_M_0tS44eOF)
- **Fibrosis (early scarring):** May partially improve over months to a year or more once inflammation drops.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1yxfrR5K-yscUQck4hQLG6LnixL6XI93MFH4xLWx3D0-hROvulBQaqEMZ_IYBtzXDP62JGswdJ_Mre6S7SQg2QccOdK2J6yLLPEf2uPvViCp9oLZul6HMT9VBMV3g14rEo_hYn4KIR1iGcsPDEJ6SYBsOt4YxQAqV4EvvrtZbD6_kL6vZJFrP8qF)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXQXy2R2V8BNDxAh49uAKLX25CxHSNp45irxEr4h7eRr6HE4GzYL6ZAuFaf4Jr48vipEYWU_h-VlAHlVIMd2zOFqLMgUDD-_C1wFjoxLKp0QF9Dy9M_S0fpvQOKqhKW7v3q_A5kod4jHxh0lxyq9E)
- **Cirrhosis (advanced scarring):** Scarring is generally permanent. Stopping alcohol still halts progression, lowers death risk, and allows some patients to regain partial liver function over time.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF17azQOztxaD9MXhDTOY0rToxe5LUG-yaCD3CN8mQ__4YjOdMLUdicQWaaoP4qhBJoFWp2kFt1VRDLPDyWHwP0SxilTpjnTFSfhpZV9LL3qKxX0KxmA3hkNgTrGw28gttRj7mIQaa86I-Le7vL7yx-j9orASbG2dmXwJp9KeRAWWATHkiv-AqdMj2)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1yxfrR5K-yscUQck4hQLG6LnixL6XI93MFH4xLWx3D0-hROvulBQaqEMZ_IYBtzXDP62JGswdJ_Mre6S7SQg2QccOdK2J6yLLPEf2uPvViCp9oLZul6HMT9VBMV3g14rEo_hYn4KIR1iGcsPDEJ6SYBsOt4YxQAqV4EvvrtZbD6_kL6vZJFrP8qF)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXYNnDfZ6bQnfzFwRbSIb_tSWUNolyhQoNQJyogW-u67NekDRfZXxoMzu9SruKQgCkgo_xf0NrJz_ZGlDiQ5C7DUQO46l6p8cL7KdA7OtDuUcyHOzC4eVRDz5O8Zq2HYmP1Q_Ng9OIsvqO)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXF8AWVDBD2DDcnL1OTOyqY4hsJxkeN67h_XYebm60Gw5r987Lohzpdi2ojBOLnz79kQH0C80oacjwPnyOhxr1XThLExj1OdD6jctjaRAetC04ltbpyVazRe4W_TrWmmd-uI0)

As documented in a review on [Natural Recovery by the Liver and Other Organs after Chronic Alcohol Use](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXhfKRrORBuB542LSDXFpx0SBVBDDro-CLHk1YjeB2dSKX_9ztSHYkeVkJdAr2UYr-rQLDQcGKYy-YCP9HcETng7L4Jrq97QRioSvGh0ZcClUTDoxeTdPswfm31gbT4i9lXomEGLaLQAtX) , the liver has a strong regenerative capacity when alcohol is removed, though relapse interrupts healing.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXhfKRrORBuB542LSDXFpx0SBVBDDro-CLHk1YjeB2dSKX_9ztSHYkeVkJdAr2UYr-rQLDQcGKYy-YCP9HcETng7L4Jrq97QRioSvGh0ZcClUTDoxeTdPswfm31gbT4i9lXomEGLaLQAtX)

### Typical Healing Timeline

- **Days to 1 week:** Liver inflammation begins dropping, and detoxification enzymes start resetting.
- **2 to 4 weeks:** Liver fat decreases, and blood markers like ALT, AST, GGT, and bilirubin often improve or normalize.
- **1 to 6+ months:** Energy, sleep, digestion, and mental clarity often improve. Ongoing repair and possible partial fibrosis reduction continue over many months.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1yV9DlheIN4ggzs1x_MTESOW1hmzId_KVkfdIBvdwJ6CHwvQNTscQZDEXRJZZdD22jb9WK202HuK-kWNnjIhuoX0qX_okv9SySP2XwneHyXVM0YSIjNYW7s6qqAXUJYFJNI6rUcftlLJTRpsxhbLfmXNIUFiqzElbBZKt2crTneZtxP-qH4o2aTQ6FY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXGN5Rm9iucXIbHFvnHthkKjRq_g_NqAZK7Isv5mEvQRgkHmkAy6_-PP_NNbBUfTZDULaUEBPyD9qea1RQOJEsAux-5fICG1cru78nocC8R5agoNm54xWlBxYJGaxP6uFBSeOwlgPmX5bZ8Bglv-RcoQ6x-WLubYo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF12PQfbZyJ7R52MjF821JI0BRI6pMrth87i-fGH3SDvDs9BY-e83BGkgt6q6-GFiR6w9i5KFDLbmGLyDiPDm0TAuHFLk4UgUss305zda5mEqNb_U6tR-A9Lf9AVY0GAx2jo7vIpeDD5sjXOmHbJ_1boIvhCxqaQZI2QTUKuxb5azr-w)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXQXy2R2V8BNDxAh49uAKLX25CxHSNp45irxEr4h7eRr6HE4GzYL6ZAuFaf4Jr48vipEYWU_h-VlAHlVIMd2zOFqLMgUDD-_C1wFjoxLKp0QF9Dy9M_S0fpvQOKqhKW7v3q_A5kod4jHxh0lxyq9E)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1yxfrR5K-yscUQck4hQLG6LnixL6XI93MFH4xLWx3D0-hROvulBQaqEMZ_IYBtzXDP62JGswdJ_Mre6S7SQg2QccOdK2J6yLLPEf2uPvViCp9oLZul6HMT9VBMV3g14rEo_hYn4KIR1iGcsPDEJ6SYBsOt4YxQAqV4EvvrtZbD6_kL6vZJFrP8qF)

### Key Steps for Safe Recovery

- **Stop alcohol completely:** Total abstinence is the main driver of liver recovery, especially beyond simple fatty liver. Guidance from [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXKSKW0xbMdJQmv68pis2jgq2EqEsVXfizxw8q09neclbDi_vZmVQd65yGlqR_dqWMQmURD-xYaSZpY2t83wJzFnFtroI7wr5E9mCpUQLjn_gDJMNvtT3VxtFcNTY2G2g1EumlhLw9Aaaul7w8WIlaiJv0-A) highlights abstinence alongside balanced nutrition—such as lean protein, whole foods, and vitamins—to support tissue repair.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXKSKW0xbMdJQmv68pis2jgq2EqEsVXfizxw8q09neclbDi_vZmVQd65yGlqR_dqWMQmURD-xYaSZpY2t83wJzFnFtroI7wr5E9mCpUQLjn_gDJMNvtT3VxtFcNTY2G2g1EumlhLw9Aaaul7w8WIlaiJv0-A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1yD9oCh-F1JSY9qp7XCxH15_j19YJ42qCk0NtG56c8tVqHKxXopSBm9l7u9XJ3pFjJqcSL8YU-eyxpomq9GRKUCzdWgR3_TT00irK1DFAQTuesCMeRURv0WyWdGwHDG3w9Bye_inrz_hAN2NBG9DLnyOVfpR_tMtIjCRtTBdX-0Hy8gZOBZdM4vtHmRfFHJz8vOz7MgQlmfjVfN4vRx_WoVrvG0GketuSrXCb_M_0tS44eOF)
- **Get medical supervision for withdrawal:** Heavy or long-term drinking can cause dangerous withdrawal symptoms if stopped abruptly. Talk to a healthcare provider before quitting.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1yV9DlheIN4ggzs1x_MTESOW1hmzId_KVkfdIBvdwJ6CHwvQNTscQZDEXRJZZdD22jb9WK202HuK-kWNnjIhuoX0qX_okv9SySP2XwneHyXVM0YSIjNYW7s6qqAXUJYFJNI6rUcftlLJTRpsxhbLfmXNIUFiqzElbBZKt2crTneZtxP-qH4o2aTQ6FY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF1yxfrR5K-yscUQck4hQLG6LnixL6XI93MFH4xLWx3D0-hROvulBQaqEMZ_IYBtzXDP62JGswdJ_Mre6S7SQg2QccOdK2J6yLLPEf2uPvViCp9oLZul6HMT9VBMV3g14rEo_hYn4KIR1iGcsPDEJ6SYBsOt4YxQAqV4EvvrtZbD6_kL6vZJFrP8qF)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF12PQfbZyJ7R52MjF821JI0BRI6pMrth87i-fGH3SDvDs9BY-e83BGkgt6q6-GFiR6w9i5KFDLbmGLyDiPDm0TAuHFLk4UgUss305zda5mEqNb_U6tR-A9Lf9AVY0GAx2jo7vIpeDD5sjXOmHbJ_1boIvhCxqaQZI2QTUKuxb5azr-w)
- **Support overall health:** Stay hydrated, get regular exercise, and avoid unnecessary liver stressors without medical guidance.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXXjCLsd4ki28nzPxeCxjOCQjBv5vhdIY6L_SwgJpjYLn3ZUl7ID2uKqtqRllTdlizmGy_BmteDU7_zX0-_E6JYoqGlPSrwk_H7OwKXTBTOaA_eBiNdyPvULsSYN2uGeT4Yy-eNk5bSw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF17azQOztxaD9MXhDTOY0rToxe5LUG-yaCD3CN8mQ__4YjOdMLUdicQWaaoP4qhBJoFWp2kFt1VRDLPDyWHwP0SxilTpjnTFSfhpZV9LL3qKxX0KxmA3hkNgTrGw28gttRj7mIQaa86I-Le7vL7yx-j9orASbG2dmXwJp9KeRAWWATHkiv-AqdMj2)

If you'd like to share a bit more context, let me know:

- Whether you're asking for **yourself or someone else** 
- If there are **known liver test results or symptoms** (like jaundice or swelling)
- What you want to focus on next—such as **withdrawal safety**, **lab markers** , or **long-term recovery** 

I can tailor the information to fit your situation.

Severe alcoholic hepatitis is life-threatening and requires urgent medical care. Fibrosis (early scarring): May partially improve over months to a year or more once inflammation drops. Cirrhosis (advanced scarring): Scarring is generally permanent. Stopping alcohol still halts progression, lowers death risk, and allows some patients to regain partial liver function over time.

Ongoing repair and possible partial fibrosis reduction continue over many months.

items.title: Key Steps for Safe Recovery
items.text: Stop alcohol completely: Total abstinence is the main driver of liver recovery, especially beyond simple fatty liver. Guidance from Cleveland Clinic highlights abstinence alongside balanced nutrition—such as lean protein, whole foods, and vitamins—to support tissue repair. Get medical supervision for withdrawal: Heavy or long-term drinking can cause dangerous withdrawal symptoms if stopped abruptly. Talk to a healthcare provider before quitting. Support overall health: Stay hydrated, get regular exercise, and avoid unnecessary liver stressors without medical guidance.
